camel_example: aliyun waf-openapi CreateDefenseTemplate --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --TemplateOrigin custom --DefenseScene waf_group --TemplateName test221 --TemplateType user_default --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --TemplateStatus 1
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi create-defense-template --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --template-name test221 --template-type user_default --template-status 1 --defense-scene waf_group --template-origin custom --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDefenseTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to obtain the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html获取当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the protection template to create. The name must be 1 to 255 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

Template names must be unique within the same protection scenario (DefenseScene)
parameters.help_zh:
要创建的防护模板名称。长度为 1~255 个字符，可以包含中文、英文、数字、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）。

相同防护场景（DefenseScene）的模板名称不能重复
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en:
The templatetype of the protection template to create. Valid values:
user_default: default protection.
user_custom: custom protection
parameters.help_zh:
要创建的防护模板类型。取值：
user_default：表示用户默认防护。
user_custom：表示用户自定义防护
parameters.name: template_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the protection template to create. Valid values:
0: Disabled.
1: Enabled
parameters.help_zh:
要创建的防护模板状态。取值：
0：表示关闭。
1：表示开启
parameters.name: template_status

parameters.help_en: The protection scenario. For more information, see the DefenseScene parameter in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461421.html
parameters.help_zh: 防护场景。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461421.html的**DefenseScene**参数
parameters.name: defense_scene

parameters.help_en: The source of the protection template to create. Set the value to custom, which indicates user-defined
parameters.help_zh: 要创建的防护模板来源。取值为custom，表示用户自定义
parameters.name: template_origin

parameters.help_en: The sub-scenario of the protection template. This parameter is supported only for the advanced bot management scenario
parameters.help_zh: 防护模版子场景。仅BOT管理高级场景支持配置
parameters.name: defense_sub_scene

parameters.help_en: The description of the protection template to create
parameters.help_zh: 要创建的防护模板描述信息
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The detailed template information, which is a JSON-formatted string. Different key-value pairs represent different attributes of the protected object. For more information, see the Detail description.

This parameter applies only to the new version of basic protection (waf_base) and the new version of bot management (bot_manager) protection scenarios. This parameter is required for the new version of bot management (bot_manager) protection scenario
parameters.help_zh:
具体模板信息，JSON格式的字符串，不同的键值对表示防护对象不同的属性，详见Detail解释。

该参数仅适用于新版基础防护（waf_base）和新版 BOT 管理（bot_manager）防护场景。在新版 BOT 管理（bot_manager）防护场景下，必须传入该参数
parameters.name: detail

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the dry run mode. If you do not specify this parameter, a normal request is sent. Valid values:

true: A dry run request is sent. The system checks whether the request meets the execution conditions without performing the specified operation. If the dry run fails, the corresponding error code is returned. If the dry run succeeds, the error code Defense.Control.DryRunOperation is returned.

false: A normal request is sent. The specified operation is performed after the request passes the check
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启 DryRun 预检模式。如果不输入该参数，表示发起正常请求。取值：

true：表示发起预检请求，仅检查请求是否满足执行条件，不执行请求指定的操作。预检不通过时返回相应错误码；预检通过时返回错误码Defense.Control.DryRunOperation。

false：表示发起正常请求；检查通过后执行请求指定的操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The protected objects to unbind when creating a default protection template. Use the format ["XX1","XX2",……].
This parameter takes effect only when creating a default template (when TemplateType is set to user_default)
parameters.help_zh:
创建默认防护模版时解除绑定的防护对象，使用["XX1","XX2",……]格式。
该参数只在创建默认模版（TemplateType取值为user_default）时生效
parameters.name: unbind_resources

parameters.help_en:
The protected object groups to unbind when creating a default protection template. Use the format ["group1","group2",……].
This parameter takes effect only when creating a default template (when TemplateType is set to user_default)
parameters.help_zh:
创建默认防护模版时解除绑定的防护对象组，使用["group1","group2",……]格式。
该参数只在创建默认模版（TemplateType取值为user_default）时生效
parameters.name: unbind_resource_groups

TemplateId.description_en: The ID of the protection template
